def getb(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            r=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; c=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(r),max(r),min(c),max(c))
    return None
def getm(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M':
            r=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; c=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(r),max(r),min(c),max(c))
    return None

print("before SPACE b:", getb(current_frame), "M:", getm(current_frame))
